title: Callbacks are reactions
description: Let incoming scans update node state, then use a timer to publish a status message. Sensor events and timer events are separate callbacks.
steps: Store the most recent forward distance when a scan arrives.
Use a 0.2-second timer to publish that distance as String on /chatter.
Observe topic hz /scan and topic echo /chatter in separate terminals. Explain which callback updates the state and which publishes it.
hints: Keep a variable or self.front between callbacks.
A timer runs periodically; a subscription runs on message arrival.
Create the scan subscription and publisher once, then let rclpy.spin dispatch the scan and timer callbacks.

nl.title: Callbacks reageren op gebeurtenissen
nl.description: Bewaar de laatste afstand uit de scan. Een aparte timer publiceert die toestand als String.
steps: Werk front bij in de scan-callback.
Publiceer front elke 0.2 s op /chatter. Bekijk berichten met ros2 topic echo /chatter in een terminal.
Vergelijk ros2 topic hz /scan met ros2 topic echo /chatter.
hints: Bewaar de waarde tussen callbacks.
Een timer is periodiek; een subscription reageert op nieuwe berichten.
Maak de endpoints één keer en gebruik rclpy.spin.

Un timer est périodique ; un abonnement réagit aux messages.
Créez les endpoints une fois puis utilisez rclpy.spin.

de.title: Callbacks reagieren auf Ereignisse

Timer laufen periodisch; Subscriptions reagieren auf Nachrichten.
Erstelle Publisher und Subscriptions einmal; rclpy.spin verteilt die Ereignisse.

it.title: I callback reagiscono agli eventi
it.description: Aggiorna lo stato del nodo quando arriva una scansione. Usa un timer per pubblicare un messaggio di stato: sensore e timer hanno callback distinti.
steps: Salva la distanza frontale più recente quando arriva una scansione.
Pubblica front ogni 0,2 s su /chatter. Osserva i messaggi con ros2 topic echo /chatter in un terminale.
Osserva topic hz /scan e topic echo /chatter in terminali separati. Spiega quale callback aggiorna lo stato e quale lo pubblica.
hints: Conserva una variabile o self.front tra i callback.
Un timer scatta periodicamente; una subscription reagisce ai messaggi in arrivo.
Crea publisher e subscription una volta sola, poi lascia che rclpy.spin gestisca gli eventi.
